findings.current: First, you can go around blabbing that the young physician named Mungyeong is actually the Slaughter Saint, then be found dead without anyone knowing.
findings.defect: The threat loses 변사체, which specifically presents him turning up as a corpse after an unnatural or mysterious death. The dangling “without anyone knowing” does not clearly preserve that no one would know how he died.
findings.rationale: 쥐도 새도 모르게 변사체로 발견되는 것 means being found mysteriously dead, with the circumstances of the death unknown.
findings.replacement: First, you can go around blabbing that the young physician named Mungyeong is actually the Slaughter Saint, then turn up mysteriously dead.

findings.defect: The explicit follow-up action of opening his mouth to answer is omitted.
findings.rationale: 입을 열었다 directly states that Jin Taekyung opened his mouth after swallowing.
findings.replacement: I swallowed hard and opened my mouth.

findings.current: as if he had finally scrubbed off some grime.
findings.defect: “Finally” adds an overdue-completion implication absent from the source, while omitting the explicit recent timing.
findings.rationale: 요새 means recently or lately; it does not mean finally.
findings.replacement: as if he had scrubbed off some grime recently.

summary: Faithful overall, with three minor losses of source-specific detail.
